newsitem.title: USA: Financial Intranet names Haggerty CEO.
newsitem.headline: Financial Intranet names Haggerty CEO.

text.p: Financial Intranet Inc said Tuesday it named Kevin Haggerty as its first chairman and chief executive officer, effective May 1.

Haggerty, with 25 years experience in the securities industry, served as senior vice president and manager for equity trading at Fidelity Capital Markets of Boston, a division of Fidelity Investments from 1990.

Financial Intranet, a new company based in New York, is a network service provider, offering a full range of on-demand financial services for participating broker/dealers and futures/commodities members.
